title: Franco Colapinto hit with five-place grid penalty for Bahrain GP in Malaysia after Baku collision
paragraphs: Franco Colapinto has been given a five-place grid penalty for next weekend’s Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia after causing a multi-car incident at the Baku City Circuit on Saturday. Colapinto was attempting to make up ground during the first Safety Car restart on Lap 36/51 when he went too deep at Turn 1, taking out both Alpine team mate Pierre Gasly and the McLaren of Lando Norris . title: Why a return to Sepang is a 'golden ticket' for Formula 1 drivers
